title: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay — premieres Nov 2.
body:
• The trailer for MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay dropped October 07, 2026.
  • Releasing Nov 2.
  • Cyclops is ready to unleash his Optic Blasts and the cosmic flames of the Phoenix on the battlefield!

The makers of MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay have released the official trailer, unveiled October 07, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
